automation_definition: Observed exposure multiplied by the penetration-weighted share of directive plus feedback-loop interactions among classified tasks.
augmentation_definition: Observed exposure multiplied by the penetration-weighted share of task iteration, validation, and learning interactions among classified tasks.
theoretical_definition: GPT-4 gamma rating (E1 + E2) from Eloundou et al.
limitation: The automation split combines March 2025 interaction labels with the 2026 task-penetration release and is unavailable where no task can be classified. It is a descriptive mixed-vintage split.
